commit.message:
feat: swap hips day cable work for machines

Both single-leg cable movements on Hips day used an ankle cuff, which is
the attachment being avoided. Hip extension moves to the standing kickback
machine and hip flexion to a captain's chair knee raise. Same two joint
actions, no cuff.

Each replacement carries the cue that distinguishes it from its failure
mode. The kickback note calls out that driving through the heel with a
free knee turns the movement into a backwards single-leg press, felt as
quad rather than glute. The knee raise keeps the psoas-above-90 cue from
the cable entry it replaces and adds the pelvis tell: neutral pelvis is
hip flexion, curling toward the ribs hands the work to the abs.

No model version bump — the cycle's days are unchanged, only the exercise
library, so this follows 003 rather than 004.

Verified by running the migration twice against the in-memory container:
first run creates 2 and removes 2, second is a clean no-op.
